finding: After factoring the final row j=512 at n=513 with 128 ranks, first_i becomes n. The search stops, but the following loop still starts at first_i/size=4. Rank 0 owns five cyclic rows, so it enters the trailing-row update for local row 4 even though no row after j exists, overwriting the just-factorized final diagonal. The loop needs a valid global trailing row; converting n to a local index is not a valid sentinel for the longer remainder partition.
